scope: Review-local font files only; no system or stable installation modified. No variable instantiation or glyph modification.
notes: STIX Two Text official release tag v2.13b171 supplies static Medium and SemiBold faces; no synthesized weight required.
Libertinus Serif has genuine Semibold (600), not a Medium (500) face. Using Semibold for emphasized headings/labels is an explicit weight difference.
Downloads/source archives may be excluded from delivery ZIP; installed fonts and OFL licenses are sufficient for reproduction.

optical_size_notes.policy: Ratios are diagnostic geometry, not an automatic recommendation or applied scaling. Same-family text/math naturally share x-height; whole-family optical enlargement would need coordinated text/math scale and new spacing checks.

actual_polytonic_probe.STIXTwoText: Partial shaping support: several polytonic characters compose despite missing precomposed cmap entries; tested ὧν fails in both NFC/NFD due missing U+0342. Do not equate missing cmap count with complete shaping failure.
actual_polytonic_probe.LibertinusSerif: All four tested polytonic words pass in NFC/NFD without missing-character warnings; all assigned Greek Extended codepoints have cmap entries.
